_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Digital tracking, provider decision support systems, and targeted client communication via mobile devices to improve primary health care
proposals.why: Most recent Cochrane review directly addressing digital tracking, provider decision support, and targeted client communication via mobile devices in primary health care.

proposals.title: Decision-support tools via mobile devices to improve quality of care in primary healthcare settings
proposals.why: Cochrane review assessing mobile-based clinical decision-support tools used by primary healthcare workers and their effects on quality of care and patient outcomes.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving maternal, neonatal, and child health
proposals.why: Cochrane review on effects of targeted reminder messages via mobile devices on maternal, neonatal, and child health outcomes.

proposals.title: Clients' perceptions and experiences of targeted digital communication accessible via mobile devices for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health: a qualitative evidence synthesis
proposals.why: Cochrane qualitative synthesis of patients' experiences receiving targeted health messages via mobile devices, informing implementation of reminder programmes.

proposals.title: WHO guideline: recommendations on digital interventions for health system strengthening
proposals.why: First WHO evidence-based guideline recommending digital tracking combined with decision support and targeted client communication via mobile devices.

proposals.title: Computer-generated reminders delivered on paper to healthcare professionals: effects on professional practice and healthcare outcomes
proposals.why: Cochrane review on computer-generated reminders to healthcare professionals and their effect on quality of care and patient outcomes.

proposals.title: The effects of on-screen, point of care computer reminders on processes and outcomes of care
proposals.why: Foundational Cochrane review on on-screen point-of-care computer reminders (prompts) and their effects on physician practice and patient health outcomes.

proposals.title: The implementation challenge of computerised clinical decision support systems for the detection of disease in primary care: systematic review and recommendations
proposals.why: Recent systematic review identifying barriers to implementing mobile/computerised decision support systems in primary care and providing implementation recommendations.
